metadata.case_name: TO WAI BUN v. HON HING MANUFACTURING COMPANY LIMITED

plaintiff.occupation_after: For four months employed as a cashier at a restaurant; thereafter employed as a casual worker earning between $500-600 per month

injuries.description: He lost the index and little fingers of his left hand.
source: He lost the index and little fingers of his left hand.
injuries.icd_description: Traumatic amputation of two or more fingers at or near base, left hand

source: I like to add that the attending surgeon has done a good job in repair of this badly crushed hand, and this present result is probably the best that can be achieved.

manifestations.description: The left wrist is mobile, but the left palm relatively rigid, and is tender if pressure is applied.
The left thumb is fixed at the finger joints, but is mobile over the base of the thumb.
It can touch the tip of the remaining 4th finger.
The tip of the shortened 4th finger is tender, and this will limit the force he can pinch and grip with the left hand.
Considerable pain and discomfort after the accident; pain in the left hand in February 1978 was directly attributed to the accident.
Ugly disfigurement to the hand (cosmetic element affecting enjoyment of life).

treatments_received: Debridement, surgical toilet. Reamputation of Index and Little Fingers. K-wire fixation of Middle Finger and Ring Finger.
Rehabilitation with a course of physiotherapy afterwards.
Arthrodesis of PEP Joint of Middle Finger.

losses.description: Loss of index and little fingers of left hand and reduced pinch and grip strength.
Ugly disfigurement to the hand affecting enjoyment of life.

comparable_cases.injury_description: Serious injury; general range of awards for pain, suffering and loss of amenities is from $60,000 to $80,000.
